record.body: Implemented a source-level repair for the reported unreadable text and missing exit path in the issue-owned crafting module. Display-only formatting now strips common catalog prefixes, replaces underscores, and bounds list/title/context/output/ingredient text so raw keys cannot overwrite adjacent columns; recipe storage, the 275-row vanilla snapshot, and custom transaction architecture are unchanged. Exit now recognizes Esc and controller B through normal/disabled game-menu, frontend, keymapping-cancel, and pause-alternate controls, and the footer explicitly says ESC / B exit. The close path also sets the bypass latch before requesting the asynchronous CRAFTING-app close, preventing the overlay from reopening on the next frame while the app is still active. Issue-local static assertions and diff whitespace checks passed. Integration still owns compilation, installation, and ASI/TSV hash parity; only in-game testing can confirm final font/layout and clean exit at portable, campfire, and grill stations.
